mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which stimulates economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are not significantly higher during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in >40% of cases when HOUST exceeds 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with an increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with the joint movement of UNRATE and PAYEMS (correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 signals increased economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in >40% of cases when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) above $600 billion signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positive in >60% of cases when RSAFS exceeds $600 billion.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.1 combined with an increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not negatively correlated with the joint movement of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (correlation > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in >40% of cases when UNRATE is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) combined with an increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are not positively correlated with the joint movement of GDPC1 and HOUST (correlation < 0.1).
